budget: One fixed setting for each viable method and one median-only control for H10. Keep the same 52 S1 and 94 S2 validation keys, labels and original folds. No tuning on these outcomes.

H06.description: Use only dated, confirmed completed repairs and replacements
needed: section ID and affected interval or segment keys
completion and availability dates before each forecast
repair type and verified initial thickness if applicable

H07.description: Restore eligible historical campaigns based on independently verified date and section assignment
needed: source campaign register with section IDs, date and availability
pre-cutoff commissioning record for excluded 2014 sections

H08.description: Set training weights based on documented independent measurement quality
needed: tool and campaign ID with pre-cutoff provenance
calibration, coverage or precision by relevant training section or campaign

H09.description: Blend latest measured minimum and historical measured minimum on the frozen S1 joint_blend baseline
H09.historical_coordinate: The published local Distance and frozen grid for 2018. The latest campaign retains the existing fold-specific alignment. Classification is exploratory because equivalence of 2018 coordinates could not be verified independently.

H10.description: Apply a spatially varying apparent thinning rate, shrunk toward the robust global rate, to the frozen S1 joint_blend baseline
H10.training: Historical eligible pairs 2018 to 2022. Leave the entire scored simple section out of rate estimation. Use only direct eligible prior minima as input for the spatial term, with median-only rate on fallback rows. Signed historical apparent rates are used; output is clipped to the existing thickness bounds.
H10.control: Apply only the same median rate and horizon to the frozen baseline
